title: State-value constraint
statement: Given a Boolean-valued function $v$ on atoms, a state descriptor consisting of an optional machine state and an output-register value, and a time-word tag $T$, define a Boolean value by evaluating $v$ on the answer atom for that state descriptor, time tag, and the zero auxiliary-word tag.
